gt_phrase: not yet at their table time

list_child.name: list_ledger_reservations
list_child.desc: Returns every table reservation recorded in the cafe's booking ledger, spanning each status from booked through no-show. This is intended for a complete sweep of the floor's bookings.

decoys.name: list_waitlist_reservations
decoys.desc: Returns every table reservation held on the cafe's walk-up waitlist, spanning each status from booked through no-show. This is intended for a sweep of groups queued for a table.

decoys.name: list_league_reservations
decoys.desc: Returns every table reservation entered on the league night sign-up sheet, spanning each status from booked through no-show. This is intended for planning seating around league play.

decoys.name: list_room_reservations
decoys.desc: Returns every table reservation held in the private party room calendar, spanning each status from booked through no-show. This is intended for a sweep of the back room's bookings.

get_child.name: get_reservation_slip
get_child.desc: Retrieves the booking slip of a single table reservation by its identifier, including its status and scheduled table time. Use this when one specific booking needs a closer look.

decoys.name: get_reservation_tab
decoys.desc: Retrieves the food and drink tab of a single table reservation by its identifier, including each item ordered and its price. Use this when a group asks to see what they owe.

decoys.name: get_reservation_checkouts
decoys.desc: Retrieves the game checkout log of a single table reservation by its identifier, including each box pulled from the library. Use this when a missing game box needs tracing.

decoys.name: get_reservation_seating
decoys.desc: Retrieves the seating chart of a single table reservation by its identifier, including the table number and chair count. Use this when floor staff need to find the group.

list_parent.name: list_guestbook_customers
list_parent.desc: Returns every customer in the cafe's guest book, along with the name and phone number on file. This is useful for building a full picture of the regular crowd.

decoys.name: list_loyalty_customers
decoys.desc: Returns every customer enrolled in the cafe's punch card club, along with the points balance on file. This is useful for spotting who is close to a free visit.

decoys.name: list_league_customers
decoys.desc: Returns every customer registered in the cafe's weekly game league, along with the standings on file. This is useful for seeding the next round of league tables.

decoys.name: list_account_customers
decoys.desc: Returns every customer holding a house account at the cafe, along with the running balance on file. This is useful for chasing the monthly settle-ups.

get_parent.name: get_customer_contact
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single customer's contact card by id, including the name and phone number on file for that guest. Use this when one particular regular needs a closer look.

decoys.name: get_customer_punchcard
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single customer's loyalty punch card by id, including the punches and rewards on file for that guest. Use this when a regular asks about a free visit.

decoys.name: get_customer_favorites
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single customer's favorite games list by id, including the titles that guest has rated highly. Use this when suggesting what a regular should play next.

decoys.name: get_customer_allergies
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single customer's allergy card by id, including the food restrictions on file for that guest. Use this when the kitchen is preparing snacks for their table.

delete_child.name: cancel_table_booking
delete_child.desc: Cancels a table reservation and erases it from the floor plan for good. The removal is permanent, so staff confirm the cancellation with the guest before running it.

decoys.name: void_table_tab
decoys.desc: Voids the food and drink tab on a table reservation and erases its line items for good. The void is permanent, so staff confirm the charges with the guest before running it.
verbs: wipe the food and drink tab for {obj}

decoys.name: forfeit_table_deposit
decoys.desc: Forfeits the deposit held on a table reservation and releases the money to the cafe for good. The forfeit is permanent, so staff confirm the late policy with the guest first.

decoys.name: scrap_table_scores
decoys.desc: Scraps the league scores logged on a table reservation and erases the results for good. The removal is permanent, so staff confirm the dispute with the players before running it.

set_enum.name: set_reservation_status
set_enum.desc: Moves a reservation's status among booked, seated, finished, and no-show. Front of house relies on this field to know where each table stands during a shift.

decoys.name: expect_reservation_status
decoys.desc: Records the status a reservation is expected to reach by closing, among booked, seated, finished, and no-show. Front of house relies on this forecast to plan table turns.

decoys.name: page_reservation_status
decoys.desc: Sets a pager alert that buzzes the host when a reservation reaches booked, seated, finished, or no-show. Front of house relies on this to catch table changes mid-shift.

decoys.name: request_reservation_status
decoys.desc: Asks a manager to approve moving a reservation to booked, seated, finished, or no-show. Front of house relies on this for status changes that affect a deposit.

set_bool.name: flag_needs_teach
set_bool.desc: Marks a reservation as needing a rules teach before play begins, so a game guide gets sent to the table. Floor staff check this flag before assigning who greets the group.
verbs: flag {obj} as needing a rules teach

decoys.name: flag_walk_in
decoys.desc: Marks a reservation as a walk-in that arrived at the door, so the host logs it against open tables. Floor staff check this flag before counting the day's advance bookings.

decoys.name: flag_large_party
decoys.desc: Marks a reservation as a large party before play begins, so two tables get pushed together. Floor staff check this flag before laying out the floor for the evening.

decoys.name: flag_birthday_table
decoys.desc: Marks a reservation as a birthday celebration before play begins, so a dessert and candle get sent to the table. Floor staff check this flag before the kitchen plates dessert.

set_ref.name: reassign_customer
set_ref.desc: Transfers a reservation from one customer's account to another, updating who the booking is under. This is typically used when a group's booking name changes at the door.

decoys.name: charge_customer
decoys.desc: Charges a reservation's food and drink tab to another customer's house account, updating who pays the bill. This is typically used when a regular covers the table.

decoys.name: credit_customer
decoys.desc: Credits a reservation's loyalty punches to another customer's card, updating who earns the visit. This is typically used when the guest paying is a club member.

decoys.name: invite_customer
decoys.desc: Sends an invite for a reservation to another customer's account, updating who is expected at the table. This is typically used when a friend joins the group late.

send.name: text_customer
send.desc: Sends a text message to the customer tied to a given reservation, or to a named customer directly. This is the cafe's standard way of confirming or adjusting a booking.

decoys.name: call_customer
decoys.desc: Places a phone call to the customer tied to a given reservation, or to a named customer directly. This is the cafe's standard way of chasing a late group.

decoys.name: page_customer
decoys.desc: Buzzes the table pager held by the customer tied to a given reservation, or by a named customer directly. This is the cafe's standard way of calling a waiting group in.

decoys.name: survey_customer
decoys.desc: Sends a feedback survey to the customer tied to a given reservation, or to a named customer directly. This is the cafe's standard way of asking how a visit went.
child_verbs: send the guest on {obj} a feedback survey

create.name: book_table
create.desc: Creates a new table reservation for a customer, with an optional game and starting status. This is how staff book a group onto the floor.

decoys.name: hold_table
decoys.desc: Creates a new tentative table hold for a customer, with an optional game and starting status. This is how staff pencil in a group until the deposit clears.

decoys.name: book_demo
decoys.desc: Creates a new publisher demo slot for a customer, with an optional game and starting status. This is how staff schedule a teach of a new release.

decoys.name: enter_tournament
decoys.desc: Creates a new tournament entry for a customer, with an optional game and starting status. This is how staff sign a player up for league night.

list_notes.name: list_reservation_notes
list_notes.desc: Returns the notes attached to a single reservation, in the order staff logged them. This covers every remark the floor has added about that booking.

decoys.name: list_reservation_requests
decoys.desc: Returns the special requests attached to a single reservation, in the order guests made them. This covers every seating or snack ask from that group.

decoys.name: list_reservation_incidents
decoys.desc: Returns the damage reports attached to a single reservation, in the order staff filed them. This covers every spill, torn card, or lost piece at that table.

decoys.name: list_reservation_tickets
decoys.desc: Returns the kitchen tickets attached to a single reservation, in the order they were fired. This covers every food and drink order sent from that table.

add_note.name: add_reservation_note
add_note.desc: Attaches a new note to a reservation, with an optional title. Floor staff use this to record remarks about a booking.

decoys.name: add_reservation_request
decoys.desc: Logs a new special request on a reservation, with an optional title. Floor staff use this to record a seating or snack ask.

decoys.name: add_damage_report
decoys.desc: Files a new damage report on a reservation, with an optional title. Floor staff use this to record a spill or a lost game piece.

decoys.name: add_kitchen_ticket
decoys.desc: Fires a new kitchen ticket for a reservation, with an optional title. Floor staff use this to send a food or drink order.

update_note.name: edit_reservation_note
update_note.desc: Changes the text of an existing note on a reservation, with an optional new title. Staff use this to correct or expand a remark after it was logged.

decoys.name: reply_reservation_note
decoys.desc: Posts a reply beneath an existing note on a reservation, with an optional title. Staff use this to answer a question a colleague logged.

decoys.name: resolve_reservation_note
decoys.desc: Resolves an existing note on a reservation with closing text and an optional title. Staff use this once the issue a remark raised is handled.

decoys.name: escalate_reservation_note
decoys.desc: Escalates an existing note on a reservation to the manager with added text and an optional title. Staff use this when a remark needs a decision.

delete_note.name: remove_reservation_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a note from a reservation. The note is erased from the booking system for good.

decoys.name: remove_note_thread
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a note and its replies from a reservation. The thread is erased from the booking system for good.

decoys.name: redact_reservation_note
decoys.desc: Permanently redacts the wording of a note on a reservation. The text is blacked out in the booking system for good.

decoys.name: withdraw_damage_report
decoys.desc: Permanently withdraws a damage report filed on a reservation. The report is struck from the incident log for good.

set_image.name: set_reservation_photo
set_image.desc: Sets the photo shown on a reservation record, typically a picture of the group at their table. Staff use it to spot the party on a busy floor.

decoys.name: set_reservation_scoresheet
decoys.desc: Sets the scoresheet photo on a reservation record, typically a snapshot of the final tally. Staff use it to settle league results after play.

decoys.name: set_reservation_setup
decoys.desc: Sets the table setup photo on a reservation record, typically a shot of the game laid out before play. Staff use it to reset the table afterward.

decoys.name: set_reservation_receipt
decoys.desc: Sets the receipt scan on a reservation record, typically a photo of the signed card slip. Staff use it to match payments at closing.

writer.name: compose_message
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the reservations it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: compose_newsletter
decoys.desc: Writes an events newsletter from a brief, which states the news in the owner's own words, and the reservations it should feature. It returns the finished newsletter.

decoys.name: compose_recap
decoys.desc: Writes a league night recap from a brief, which states the results in the host's own words, and the reservations it should cover. It returns the finished recap.

decoys.name: compose_invitation
decoys.desc: Writes a party invitation from a brief, which states the details in the organizer's own words, and the reservations it should list. It returns the finished invitation.

image.name: render_artwork
image.desc: Generates an artwork from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the artwork.

decoys.name: render_poster
decoys.desc: Generates an event poster from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the poster.

decoys.name: render_menuboard
decoys.desc: Generates a menu board graphic from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the board.

decoys.name: render_tablecard
decoys.desc: Generates a table tent card from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the card.

search.name: search_faq
search.desc: Searches the booking system's FAQ pages with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to check how the booking system works.

decoys.name: search_rulebooks
decoys.desc: Searches the game rulebook library with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to settle a rules dispute at a table.

decoys.name: search_allergens
decoys.desc: Searches the kitchen allergen guide with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to check what is in a snack.

decoys.name: search_policies
decoys.desc: Searches the house policy binder with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to check deposit and damage rules.
